subject.title: fix(code-mode): preserve direct tools and secure suspended runs

question: Should suspended Code Mode runs reject every resume request that omits any identity field recorded at suspension, after confirming all supported resume callers supply those fields?
rationale: This is an intentional fail-closed authorization change: the code direction is security-motivated, but maintainers must confirm that the stricter caller contract does not strand legitimate persisted work.

options.title: Confirm strict ownership contract
options.body: Audit supported resume entry points, add any missing caller-identity regression coverage, and merge with the proposed fail-closed behavior.

options.title: Preserve partial-caller compatibility
options.body: Keep the existing guarded comparisons and add a narrower authorization mechanism if callers cannot consistently provide the stored identity fields.

recommendation.title: Confirm strict ownership contract
recommendation.body: Audit supported resume entry points, add any missing caller-identity regression coverage, and merge with the proposed fail-closed behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available branch and linked-report context show direct ownership of the proposed Code Mode behavior, although current-main ownership history was not available for confirmation.
